options.blurb: Screen 500 filings in batches of 40: code drops empties, duplicates and future items, then one Choice keyed by filing id picks the one an analyst should open first for going-concern or dilution risk.

outputs.meaning: the outcome is the picked item id
rejected in code before any Jev call (non NYSE/Nasdaq venue, future data, or bad input)

options.jev_calls: 1 call per batch of <= 40 items (500 items = 13 calls)

when: venue is not NYSE or Nasdaq: out of scope
an item is published after the data cutoff
duplicate item ids: rejected in code
more than 40 items in one batch: split in code

outcomes.meaning: =open first.choice
when: otherwise

outcomes.meaning: abstain: no outcome, a person reviews
when: no items: missing evidence stays unresolved

ITEM 1. Business

We design and manufacture semiconductors that we sell to electronics designers and manufacturers all over the world. Our operations began in 1930, and we are incorporated in Delaware.
